notes.summary: Number System is the base of all Quant: types of numbers, divisibility, unit digits and remainders. SSC asks 1–2 questions in Tier 1 and 2–3 in Tier 2.

concepts.title: Types of numbers
concepts.body:
• Natural: 1, 2, 3, …
  • Whole: 0, 1, 2, …
  • Prime: exactly two factors. 2 is the only even prime; 1 is neither prime nor composite.
  • Co-prime: HCF is 1, e.g. 8 and 15.

concepts.title: Divisibility rules
concepts.body: 3 / 9: sum of digits divisible by 3 / 9. 4: last two digits. 8: last three digits. 11: (sum of odd-place digits) − (sum of even-place digits) is 0 or a multiple of 11.

concepts.title: Unit digit cycles
concepts.body: Unit digits repeat in cycles of 4: 2 → 2, 4, 8, 6; 3 → 3, 9, 7, 1; 7 → 7, 9, 3, 1; 8 → 8, 4, 2, 6. Digits 0, 1, 5, 6 never change. Divide the power by 4 and use the remainder (remainder 0 means the 4th term).

varieties.name: Unit digit of a power
varieties.how: Find the remainder of the power ÷ 4 and pick that term of the cycle.

varieties.name: Missing digit for divisibility
varieties.how: Apply the rule for the divisor and solve for the missing digit.

example.q: If 4x56 is divisible by 9, find x.

varieties.name: Remainders
varieties.how: Reduce the base using a small power that leaves remainder 1 (or −1), or use the divisor’s factor.

tips: For unit digit of a product, multiply only the unit digits.
If N leaves remainder r with divisor D, and d is a factor of D, the remainder with d is r mod d.
Largest n-digit number divisible by k = 99…9 − (99…9 mod k).
traps: When the power is a multiple of 4, use the 4th term of the cycle (e.g. 6 for base 2), not the 1st.

questions.q: What is the unit digit of 7<sup>95</sup>?
questions.solution:
Cycle of 7: 7, 9, 3, 1 (length 4).
95 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 3.
3rd term of the cycle = 3.

questions.q: If the number 5432x7 is divisible by 9, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Sum of known digits = 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 7 = 21.
21 + x must be a multiple of 9 → 21 + x = 27.
x = 6.

questions.q: What is the remainder when 2<sup>31</sup> is divided by 5?
questions.solution:
24 = 16 leaves remainder 1 when divided by 5.
231 = (24)7 × 23.
Remainder = 1 × 8 = 8 → 8 ÷ 5 leaves 3.

questions.q: What is the unit digit of 3<sup>65</sup> × 6<sup>59</sup> × 7<sup>71</sup>?
questions.solution:
365: 65 ÷ 4 leaves 1 → unit digit 3.
659: unit digit is always 6.
771: 71 ÷ 4 leaves 3 → unit digit 3.
3 × 6 × 3 = 54 → unit digit 4.

questions.q: A number when divided by 357 leaves a remainder of 39. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 17?
questions.solution:
357 = 17 × 21, so 17 divides 357 exactly.
N = 357k + 39, so the remainder with 17 = 39 mod 17.
39 = 2 × 17 + 5 → remainder 5.
